summary: Enhance your skills in social protection for the elderly and PWDs. Join our comprehensive training program to make a meaningful impact in your community.
lede: Social protection for older people and persons with disabilities focuses on identifying access barriers and building inclusive benefit and service pathways. Designed for programme managers, social policy and disability inclusion professionals, and monitoring specialists, the course covers needs assessment, accessible enrollment and delivery, referral coordination, and disability-disaggregated monitoring using tools such as service journey mapping and the Washington Group Short Set of Questions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, deliver, fund, monitor, or advocate for social protection for the elderly and PWDs. You will benefit most if you work directly with entitlement design, beneficiary identification, service access, referral coordination, monitoring, or policy reporting.
prerequisites: No formal technical background is required beyond working familiarity with social protection, disability inclusion, or public service programmes. Bring a laptop, a current programme example, and any available beneficiary, access, or monitoring data so you can complete the exercises using realistic material from your own context.
